changes.body_friction: Replace per-contact .22/.65 tangential velocity scaling with Coulomb friction capped by the actual normal impulse, with separate cushioned/passive restitution. Near-unloaded back/thigh contacts retain downward sliding velocity under gravity instead of being damped toward a suspended ball. Keep real swept weighted-skin contact and geometric acceptance, never apply a proximity possession or ball kick. Eight numeric checks cover grazing vertical slide, non-increasing stationary-skin energy, dissipation and separating balls.
changes.visible_height_receiving: A full-body reception reference uses three unchanged native knee/crotch/chest sources and their runtime mirrors. Forecast height/side select the reference; a committed arrival deadline advances its preparation, and actual measured receipt starts its withdrawal phase. Opposite-leg two-bone IK retains a support endpoint, authored limb lengths remain fixed, and head world orientation is preserved for look/camera alignment. The layer applies to the existing native rig in human and CPU without importing rejected Unity locomotion.
changes.aim_during_windup: Suppress automatic repeated held-stick reversals while a human pass/shot action is preparing. An explicit new stick direction can still retarget; ordinary repeated-turn locomotion resumes after the action. A rear pass changed on release previously started a second reversal and could turn back forward before contact.
changes.native_handoff: A queued native touch releases the reception reference as its impact approaches. Once that touch is made, its own authored continuation remains authoritative: do not unmask the old high-reception pose on a ball-control foot after touchMade becomes true. Keep action/contact gates and the existing native football selector.
changes.vertical_reflex: Use the actual contact lever crossed with incoming relative velocity to orient a bounded protective angular reference. A Z-cross-velocity surrogate gave exactly zero for a vertical arriving ball. Preserve the first impact phase through low repeated support contacts rather than erasing or restarting its reaction every tick. A numeric descending-offset impact test measures the resulting torso rotation and unchanged bone lengths.
changes.continuing_receipts: Human and CPU reception assistance can continue for a nearby elevated own nonkicked/accidental first touch instead of immediately dropping the receiving state. Own kicked passes/shots remain excluded; a trap or other real skin hit must still be selected and completed.
changes.laboratory: 7/8/9/0 plus F5 arrange shin/thigh/descending-upper/backdrop trajectories; H additionally targets a CPU teammate in the physical match. Shin/thigh fixtures use lower origins and 420 ms flight to reach the intended limb without crossing the chest first. These only arrange positions/flight, not action choice or contact outcome. New final-render knee/elbow telemetry accompanies the existing torso/ankles.

learned_motor.algorithm: cross-entropy neural policy search on perturbed angular dynamics
learned_motor.scope: Learned upper-body angular servo with native motion references and domain-randomized reduced dynamics. Not Euphoria, AMP, a trained whole-body locomotion/balance policy, or proof of full-body sim-to-game transfer.

investigated_findings: Repeated tangential velocity scaling creates artificial damping even for tiny normal loads. The new impulse-based friction preserves a sliding ball instead; actual late ball height/distance in the ten new rendered arrival trials verifies that it does not remain suspended near the receiving actor.

A purely vertical incoming ball produced zero Z-cross-velocity reflex. The actual impact lever supplies a direction and the trained upper-body tracker follows a bounded protective target, with a dedicated numeric regression.

Recomputing a closest-root-point arrival every tick could keep the reference preparation at frame zero. Commit a forecast deadline for its preparation and use an actual skin event for the withdrawal clock. Existing native actions and the final contact pose remain authoritative.

A reception reference was allowed to become fully visible again after touchMade changed to true on native ball control. The final handoff now stays with that native action; the final release rechecks all receipt/contact/camera suites on the final hash.

The first thigh fixture had a high origin and its arc met the chest at 1.11 m before its nominal .80 m target. Native chest selection was valid. The corrected physical trajectory enters the thigh corridor; unchanged actual limb-lift criteria pass for both human and CPU.

A live 22-player walking fixture can legitimately reach a foul/restart. A no-displacement assertion first rejected the native RESTART_PREPARED reposition, then an exact-timestamp match to sparsely sampled match telemetry produced no adjacent pairs. The final test excludes only explicitly logged restart preparation intervals +/-100 ms, still requires over 30 ordinary frame pairs and less than .30 m displacement per100 ms. Walking speed, alternate swing, support and stance-slip criteria remain unchanged.

The contextual LT fixture initially waited 800 ms after changing possession without holding LT. A real native foot touch at t8430 recovered the ball before LT at t9000, so LT correctly protected instead of grabbing. The final fixture settles first and holds contextual LT across the F11 ownership change, retaining all hand/force/slowdown/escape thresholds.

The ordinary-walk style fraction initially included stationary native restart-wait poses. The final test uses independently measured simulation speed above .20 m/s for moving samples, demands at least15 samples, retains the >75% full-walk proportion plus the original travel, alternating swing, support and stance-slip criteria.

The rear-pass-on-release test exposed a real repeated-turn action bug: the held rear stick began a second automatic reversal before the pass contacted the ball, causing a forward-facing release after1560 ms. Suppressing automatic repeats during action preparation fixes that behavior without blocking deliberate aim changes.

The v7 release queue was intentionally interrupted before completion to correct the native post-contact handoff. Its partial results and earlier preflights are excluded from release pass counts. All 36 cases below use the final native hash.
limits: Graphical regression tests run on Linux/X11 with a virtual Xbox controller. Windows is cross-compiled and its complete portable package/DLL imports are checked; Windows runtime/controller feel still needs the user PC.

The neural model remains the approved six-unit18-weight upper-body angular servo. New leg support/reference selection and collision response are analytical, not a new learned whole-body gait, machine-learned biomechanics or proprietary Euphoria.
Three existing authored reception sources plus mirrors and continuous adaptation are not hundreds of new captures. Existing procedural catalog/profile counts are unchanged.

The ten scripted arrival trials and other regressions validate concrete situations and the final rendered skeleton. They do not prove universal control of every ball, human-equivalent movement, absence of every penetration or perfect anatomical motion.

Genuine hard/backside hits can deflect instead of being controlled. Native action feasibility, skin contact and reach still govern possession; the controlled-ground-dribble collision exemption remains.
